 "path": "/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL-openclaw-luna6-high-rnd0/frozen/held-out/play/users/u010/system/state/workspace/programs/task-6fe8083c.py",
 "content": "def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    from collections import Counter
    bg = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    zeros = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == 0]
    sr, sc = min(r for r, c in zeros), min(c for r, c in zeros)
    er, ec = max(r for r, c in zeros), max(c for r, c in zeros)
    source = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] not in (bg, 0)]
    ar, ac = min(r for r, c in source), min(c for r, c in source)
    br, bc = max(r for r, c in source), max(c for r, c in source)
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r in range(er - sr + 1):
        for c in range(ec - sc + 1):
            out[sr + r][sc + c] = grid[ar + r][bc - c]
    return out
